nce/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) use
s MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` ro
ute (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md):
Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately: the proxy fails a revoked lease closed f
rom that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather tha
n something a caller must do.\n- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-inges
tion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.\n- [Appen
d iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one bat
ch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.\n- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an ev
al. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no
debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n- [Open a run for incremen
tal ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.md): Opens a run that iteratio
ns are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and `runs/finalize`.\n- [Get a run's ga
te waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-gate-waiver.md): The waiver in force over this run, or `null
`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not only to those who can grant one: a waiver its readers cannot see is not a visible
waiver.\n- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/waive-a-run-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's rele
ase gate until an expiry you name. This does NOT make the run pass: the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited r
ecord, and every surface that honors it, such as the CLI's `eval gate`, reports the gate as waived, by whom, why, and until when.\
n- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-gate-waiver.md): End a waiver early, putting th
e gate back. Requires the manage tier.\n- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-deterministic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permissi
on and a terminal run. Reserves a 60-second deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned con
tinuation object with the unchanged draft to read the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second ope
rat…\n- [Get the host-compat catalog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-host-compat-catalog.md): The versioned
host-compatibility catalog backing `mcpjam compat` verdicts. Public and unauthenticated: static host facts and creation config wi
th no project or user scope. Always returns a catalog: `source` is `live` when the published catalog was reachable and `bundled` w
hen serving the SDK's built…\n- [Get the authenticated account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-authenticate
d-account.md): The user behind the API key (keys act as their creator, scoped to one organization).\n- [Read the organization's sp
end budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organi
zation may spend on MCPJam-billed work (chat, evals, judges and computer time) in the current billing window, and how much of it h
as been spent.\n- [Set the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/set-the-organizations-spend-
budget.md): Set or replace the ceiling. **Requires organization owner or admin.**\n- [Remove the organization's spend budget](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/remove-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Leave the organization uncapped. **Requires o
rganization owner or admin.**\n- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The or
ganizations the caller belongs to: the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts
. An API key is bound to one organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes a
re not part of the public API.\n- [List projects](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-projects.md): Projects the ca
ller can access. API keys only ever see projects inside the key's organization.\n- [List a project's servers](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-servers.md): The MCP servers saved in the project: the `serverId`s every other route tak
es. STDIO command/args/env and raw headers are never exposed.\n- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in the project with latest-run summaries and pass-rate trends: the `suite
Id`s the eval-run routes take.\n- [List chat sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-chat-sessions.md): Chat
sessions visible to the caller (personal + project-shared merged). Top-level rather than project-nested because `projectId` is an
optional filter, not an owning scope.\n- [The MCPJam-provided model catalog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/the-mcp
jam-provided-model-catalog.md): PUBLIC: this route carries no user or project data and requires no bearer token.\n- [Export projec
t traces as OTLP/JSON](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/export-project-traces-as-otlpjson.md): Returns an OTLP `Expor
tTraceServiceRequest`. Pagination rides in RESPONSE HEADERS rather than the body so the payload stays a valid OTLP document: read
`x-mcpjam-next-cursor` and feed it back as `cursor`, and treat `x-mcpjam-export-complete: true` as the end of the stream.\n- [List
a project's clients](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/list-a-projects-clients.md): The clients saved in the project:
the named, reusable configurations that define how MCPJam connects to and talks to your MCP servers. Returns the `id`s and `confi
gId`s the detail and write routes take. Clients that exist only as the private backing of a User Testing study are omitted unless
`includ…\n- [Create a client (from a template or a full config)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/create-a-client-fro
m-a-template-or-a-full-config.md): Creates a client in the project and responds `201` with the new client's detail. Seed the confi
g one of two ways: pass `template` (a built-in template id, optional `theme`) to seed server-side from the live client-template ca
talog, falling back to the bundled SDK catalog snapshot if the live catalog…\n- [Get a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/clients/get-a-client.md): One client's full settings, including its resolved config, its `configId` (the concurrency token ever
y write takes), and `impact`: what a config edit would follow. The path segment accepts a client **name or ID**. A client that exi
sts but belongs to a different project reads as `404 NOT_FOUND`.\n- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/client
s/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite st
ill holds it: the error names what to detach first. Guest callers are denied (a write).\n- [Update a client](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/clients/update-a-client.md): Edit a client's display name and/or its config. Two ways to change the config: `conf
ig` replaces it wholesale, and `set` changes named fields over the config read inside the write transaction. Prefer `set`, because
a whole-config round-trip composed from a stale read reverts whatever landed in betwe…\n- [Replace a client's servers](https://do
cs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/replace-a-clients-servers.md): Replaces the client's required and optional saved-server attach
